hook: Ration may add dal, sugar, atta to your *6 kg* rice
hook_b: Ration may add dal, sugar, atta to your *6 kg* rice
tldr: Civil Supplies Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy asked officials for financially viable options to add essential items to ration supplies.

beats.what: Food Security Card holders get 6 kg of fine rice per person a month through ration shops.
beats.why: The state cites anticipated drought and expected price rises; the CM wants an expanded basket.
beats.care: Items studied include wheat flour, red gram, sugar, tamarind, palm oil and chilli powder.

event.label: Options sought for bigger ration basket

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The options go to a Cabinet Sub-committee, keeping the state's finances in view.

cards.q: Which extra ration item would matter most at home?

qs: How much would each added item cost the state per month?

facts.t: The minister also ordered *10 lakh metric tonnes* of silo storage across the state.
Farmers get a *₹500 per quintal* bonus on seven notified fine paddy varieties.

steps.e: Govt says it is examining more items

viz.verdict: Cardholders may gain items; cost to the state is still being worked out.

cover.label: Fine rice per person a month now

learn.t: FSC = Food Security Card, Telangana's ration card for subsidised grain

watch: The Cabinet Sub-committee's call on which items and quantities are funded.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Telangana CM keen on expanding ration basket

fact: Telangana weighs adding wheat flour, dal and sugar to the *6 kg* rice ration
twist: Only cardholders in *GHMC limits* get wheat today; elsewhere it is rice alone.
